name: Create an Expense
raw_text:
Create an Expense
POST
https://external-integrations.mycase.com/v1/expenses

Create an individual expense.

Request
Body
application/json
application/json
activity_name
string
required

The activity name associated with this expense. If there is no matching activity already in MyCase, one will be created with this name.

description
string
billable
boolean
required

Whether or not this expense is billable.

entry_date
string
required

The entry date of this expense. Must be in ISO 8601 date format.

cost
number
required
units
number
required
case
object
required
id
integer
required
staff
object
id
integer
